title: Tonight's Member Show
snippet: I am moving tonight’s member show to tomorrow. I have been working on the show all day and I keep hearing this feedback coming from my soundboard….driving me crazy. This low pitched ringing sound. I have been tweaking with the settings trying to figure out what is causing it or where it is coming…
